versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Technical Writer / Documentation Specialist Roadmap API.
- Generate personalized technical writing career roadmaps based on user skills, experience, tools, and career goals.
- Endpoints provided for health check, roadmap generation, specialization listing, and learning paths.
- Roadmap responses include phases, objectives, resources, skill gaps, and next steps.
- Comprehensive documentation with sample requests, responses, and available pricing plans.
